workload_rules.observed_pattern: Long context at the latency tail
workload_rules.evidence: Input tokens are {value} at P95, above the {threshold} threshold.
workload_rules.action: Test a reduced-context variant: summarize history, remove repeated context, or retrieve only relevant content; compare the latency profile.

workload_rules.evidence: Prompt-cache usage is {value}, below the {threshold} threshold.
workload_rules.action: Use a stable prompt prefix, then rerun the same test.

workload_rules.evidence: Output tokens are {value} at P95, at or above the {threshold} threshold.
workload_rules.action: Ask for a shorter response, then compare total response time.

workload_rules.evidence: Peak request rate is {value}x average ({peak_rpm} vs {average_rpm} requests/min).
workload_rules.action: Send requests at a steadier rate, then compare latency and throttling.

workload_rules.evidence: Only {value} of requests use streaming, below the {threshold} threshold.
workload_rules.action: Enable streaming for an interactive test cohort and measure time to first visible response.

offer_rules.fit: Bursty or variable interactive traffic that needs lower latency without reserved capacity.
offer_rules.action: Replay the same workload with Priority Processing and compare TBT P95.
offer_rules.tradeoff: Higher per-token cost; some requests can fall back to Standard.

offer_rules.fit: Steady, sustained traffic that needs predictable latency and throughput.
offer_rules.action: Verify quota and live capacity, create a PTU-M test deployment, and replay the same workload.
offer_rules.tradeoff: Requires PTU sizing, available quota, and a capacity commitment.

missing_request_data.evidence: {metric} {percentile} and token distributions cannot be computed from platform averages.
missing_request_data.action: Configure or verify Log Analytics diagnostic settings, collect new representative traffic, and rerun. Logs are not retroactive.

insufficient_metric_data.evidence: The selected window contains {metric_sample_count} usable {metric} samples; at least {minimum_metric_samples} are required.
insufficient_metric_data.action: Collect representative traffic over a normal production window, then rerun.

insufficient_request_data.evidence: The selected window contains {request_count} requests; at least {minimum_request_samples} are required.
insufficient_request_data.action: Collect representative traffic over a normal production window, then rerun.

target_unavailable.evidence: No comparable {metric} {percentile} target is available for this model, version, and offer.
target_unavailable.action: Review the target catalog coverage before drawing a latency conclusion.

benchmark_coverage_gap.action: Attach the evidence package to support and request a comparable benchmark cohort.

unexplained_gap.evidence: Observed {metric} {percentile} remains above both the current-offer target and the matched benchmark reference.
unexplained_gap.action: Generate the evidence package and contact support before evaluating another offer.

above_target_explained.observed_pattern: Latency aligns with the matched workload benchmark
above_target_explained.evidence: Observed {metric} {percentile} is above the current-offer target but at or below the matched benchmark reference.
above_target_explained.action: Use the benchmark context when deciding whether to optimize the workload or define a stricter application goal.

within_target.evidence: Observed {metric} {percentile} is within the current-offer target.
